basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old construction worker based in Reno, NV, who has recently discovered the vast world of Reddit. While my day job involves building structures and working with my hands, my evenings are often spent diving into video games like GTA V and exploring intriguing true crime stories through bands like SKYND. My job is demanding, but I find solace in humor, which is why I enjoy shows like Reno 911. I'm currently single, focusing on my career and hobbies. I usually browse Reddit in the late evenings, after 8 PM, when I can unwind and relax.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Most of my knowledge comes from hands-on experience in construction and a deep interest in gaming and true crime stories. My expertise in these areas is largely self-taught, supplemented by online forums and community discussions.
